blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Heritage Woods. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Heritage Woods, Port Moody: 23 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 4%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 2 of 11 Port Moody communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Moody total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Heritage Woods rose from 20 in June to 23 in October (+15.0%), and 12 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 16.7% of Port Moody’s 138 houses listed.

items.t: 3522: east of Heritage Mountain, centred on David Avenue east.
No street-by-street boundary is published; the Parkland Strategy groups Heritage Woods with Heritage Mountain and Twin Creeks, divided by Heritage Mountain Boulevard and David Avenue.
Route 183 streets: Forest Park Way, Panorama Drive; David Avenue to Pinetree Way, Coquitlam.

blocks.text: Heritage Woods Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: 2937 applies identically.
Heritage Woods is outside the Transit-Oriented Areas, which are exempt from SSMUH — the reverse applies here.
Development Permit Area 4 restricts tree, vegetation removal, grading; check OCP Map 13 or ViewPort — Forest Park Way lots especially.
Tree removal needs a permit, arborist report, Tree Protection Bylaw, 2026, No. 3531.

blocks.text: Heritage Woods Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: North Shore Community Park: 1400 David Avenue, courts; 1300 David Avenue, fields with lights.
Heritage Mountain Community Centre, 200 Panorama Place, is in Heritage Woods — despite its name.
Parkland Strategy count, combined area: 10 play spaces, 10 sports amenities, one off-leash area.
David Avenue reaches Pinetree Way, so east-end houses use Coquitlam Central Station.

blocks.text: Heritage Woods Houses: getting around

items.t: Route 183: Coquitlam Central via Panorama Drive, Forest Park Way, David Avenue, Heritage Mountain Boulevard, Ioco Road to Moody Centre.
Route 184 serves Noons Creek Drive, not Forest Park Way.

blocks.text: Heritage Woods Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Bert Flinn-backing houses are forest-interface lots: OCP interface management applies under the Community Wildfire Protection Plan.
Development Permit Area 5 (Hazardous Lands, Steep Slopes) applies with Area 4 on hillside lots.
City hazards page: Port Moody is surrounded by forests, so wildfire risk applies; see FireSmart Canada.

Heritage Woods home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

23 houses sold in Heritage Woods with a median price of $2,098,000 (the middle half sold between $1,872,500 and $2,265,000), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $558 per square foot, a median year built of 2004 and a median lot of 6,515 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Heritage Woods?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 23 houses listed in Heritage Woods. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Heritage Woods a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Heritage Woods had a sales ratio of 4%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Heritage Woods from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 12 houses sold in Heritage Woods over those 5 months, out of 64 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Heritage Woods?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
Both border this area: Aspenwood Elementary is at 2001 Panorama Drive on the Heritage Woods side, Heritage Mountain Elementary at 125 Ravine Drive west.
Eagle Mountain Middle, Grades 6 to 8, at 110 Dogwood Drive in Anmore is the middle school in the provincial list for this catchment family.

faq.q: What did houses in Heritage Woods sell for?
faq.a: 23 houses sold in Heritage Woods between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,098,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Heritage Woods?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.8% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
